# Prototype phases

| Phase | Deliverable | Acceptance criterion |
|---|---|---|
| A | Toolchain + minimal ROM | Actual ROM build and emulator boot evidence |
| B | 2-room renderer | Fixed cameras, visual room changes |
| C | Player movement | Tank controls and animation states |
| D | Collision + stairs | Walls, floors, stairs tested |
| E | Door transitions | Stable repeated transitions |
| F | Vertical slice | One enemy, basic combat, HUD/audio/save as feasible |

Phase A is the next task. Keep all later phases gated on a real bootable N64 ROM.
